description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for widget condition models within the Apache OFBiz framework, focusing on representing XML elements as immutable, thread-safe condition objects with various subclasses modeling specific condition types.

classes.name: ModelWidgetCondition
classes.description: An abstract base class representing a read-only condition model for widgets, capable of evaluation based on a context, with various subclasses implementing specific condition logic.

classes.name: And
classes.description: A composite condition that evaluates to true if all subconditions evaluate to true.

classes.name: Condition
classes.description: Interface defining a boolean evaluation based on a context map.

classes.name: ConditionFactory
classes.description: Interface for factories creating Condition instances from XML elements.

classes.name: DefaultConditionFactory
classes.description: Default implementation of ConditionFactory that creates various condition types based on XML element names.

classes.name: IfCompare
classes.description: Condition representing a comparison between a widget field's value and a specified value.

classes.name: IfCompareField
classes.description: Condition representing a comparison between two widget fields.

classes.name: IfEmpty
classes.description: Condition checking if a specified field's value is empty.

classes.name: IfEntityPermission
classes.description: Condition checking entity permissions using OFBiz's permission checker.

classes.name: IfHasPermission
classes.description: Condition that checks if the current user possesses certain permissions.

classes.name: IfRegexp
classes.description: Condition to match a field's string value against a regex pattern.

classes.name: IfServicePermission
classes.description: Condition checking whether a user has permission for a specific service.

classes.name: IfValidateMethod
classes.description: Condition invoking a static validation method via reflection to determine truth.

classes.name: Or
classes.description: A condition that evaluates to true if any subcondition is true.

classes.name: Xor
classes.description: A condition that evaluates to true if exactly one subcondition is true.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition against a context map.

methods.name: readSubConditions
methods.description: Reads and constructs subconditions from XML element children.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new Condition instance based on the XML element.
